index.label: Indeks Pasokan Mineral untuk Peningkatan Nilai Tambah Dalam Negeri
index.scope: ESDM composite ministry performance index, NOT an international critical-mineral security rating.
index.methodology_warning: Renstra 2025–2029 modifies both the index name and its formula. Historic series belongs to the 2025 reporting framework and must not be blindly continued under the new indicator.

processing.material_note: ESDM source contains internally awkward ozT/million notation; 483.04 tonnes quoted as explicit equivalent and not assumed mine ore tonnage.

processing.unit: ton raw nickel material reported, NOT contained Ni

scope_utilization: 2025 Q4 processing/smelter facility utilisation is limited to integrated IUP/IUPK facilities under ESDM. Standalone IUI industrial smelters overseen by Kemenperin are outside this perimeter; values above 100% may reflect reporting/capacity denominator effects.

p3dn.note: Provisional 2025 Q4 P3DN realised domestic product procurement; incomplete enterprise reporting.

tkdn.note: 2025 Q4 share of certified domestic content in local goods expenditure; self-assessment and partial documentation.

investment.scope: Minerba = minerals AND coal, plus services. This US$7.008bn is NOT verified critical-mineral-only investment and must not be presented as such.

categories.name: Special Mining Business Permit (IUPK)
categories.note: Multi-commodity; cannot isolate critical minerals from this report.

categories.name: SOE Mining Business Permit (IUP BUMN)
categories.note: Scope is permit owner, not proof of mineral-only spending.

categories.name: Mining Services Business Permit (IUPJ)
categories.note: Minerals/coal services are not split into project/commodity expenditure.

investment.note: Figures from investment table are rounded; category sum can differ slightly from headline (US$7,008.13m). Avoid adding to BKPM or IEA greenfield pipeline figures.

actors.name: Ditjen Minerba · Kementerian ESDM
actors.role: IUP/IUPK integrated smelter performance reporting, MOMS production/processing oversight, mineral investment monitoring.

actors.name: Kementerian Perindustrian (Kemenperin)
actors.role: Standalone industrial processing/refining (IUI) outside ESDM-integrated smelter utilization denominator.

actors.name: Kementerian Investasi dan Hilirisasi / BKPM
actors.role: 2025 cross-government reconciliation of refinery data and investment facilitation.

actors.name: Badan Geologi · Kementerian ESDM
actors.role: Geological mapping, critical/strategic mineral resource analysis and policy recommendations.

actors.name: PT Sucofindo
actors.role: ESDM-linked study to support mineral TKDN benchmarks and procurement verification.

risks.title: Quarterly RKAB reporting gaps
risks.detail: Some mineral IUP holders reported late, particularly Q4; administrative lag affects completeness and timing of production indices.

risks.title: Smelter power and infrastructure constraints
risks.detail: Unfinished processing facilities face financing, electricity supply, accessibility and land-use issues.

risks.title: Nickel excess supply / fragile performance
risks.detail: High processed nickel output and smelter expansion do not guarantee sustainable raw material supply or balanced market pricing; skill, spatial and environmental constraints persist.

risks.title: Dual supervision of processing
risks.detail: Integrated IUP smelters fall under ESDM while industrial stand-alone IUI plants fall under Kemenperin, requiring cross-agency data alignment.

risks.title: TKDN evidence quality
risks.detail: Some enterprise figures rely on self-assessment; the report notes incomplete reporting and a limited mineral procurement obligation in company plans.

risks.title: Investment conversion & permitting
risks.detail: IPPKH, RKAB revisions, land price negotiations, rainfall, procurement and vendor issues constrain delivery.

risks.title: Critical mineral supply chain outcome measurement
risks.detail: The ESDM performance review calls for explicit outcome measures on critical-mineral supply security and environmental/social impacts of downstreaming.

policy_outputs.name: MOMS expansion
policy_outputs.description: Mineral Online Monitoring System launched / extended to bauxite and iron, as well as copper, gold, galena, manganese, zinc and lead.

policy_outputs.name: Strategic supply index reform
policy_outputs.description: 2025–2029 Renstra renamed/reworked the composite index as Indeks Pengelolaan Mineral dan Peningkatan Nilai Tambah Dalam Negeri.

policy_outputs.name: 2025 raw-to-refined product categories
policy_outputs.description: Gold/silver metal, tin metal, copper cathode, NPI, ferronickel, nickel matte, CGA and SGA referenced; listing a product does not prove global battery-grade capacity.

policy_outputs.name: Mineral investment monitoring
policy_outputs.description: Monthly corporate reports and sector investment monitoring through Ditjen Minerba; mineral investment cannot be disaggregated into critical minerals from this one total.

methodology: Source: ESDM ministry LAKIN 2025, issued 27 February 2026. PDF pagination includes introductory pages: user-facing page labels are printed report pages, PDF pages differ.
The nickel 313.67 million-ton figure is reported RAW MATERIAL tonnes in the ESDM processing-ratio KPI. It is not USGS/IEA mined contained-Ni tonnes, refined nickel production, or national NI stocks.
ESDM quotes 100% physical nickel processing ratio and 103% target achievement: these are not conflicting measurements. The latter compares 100 with 97 targeted.
Reported 2025 ore processing ratio data are limited by smelter integration and submitted administrative data; the data do not prove all standalone smelters or mined ore nationally are covered.
Some Q4 2025 P3DN/TKDN numbers are provisional or self-assessed; 117% silver utilisation must not be interpreted as verified physical capacity exceeding maximum engineering throughput.
2025 minerba investment is MINERAL AND COAL; US$363.9m IUP mineral is only one mining-permit class, NOT a comprehensive mineral/critical mineral economy estimate.
Raw ore tonnes, metal content, product tonnes, facility utilisation percentages, investment dollars and composite-score points are different measures and cannot be summed.
ESDM 2025 series are national programme KPIs: they must not overwrite USGS MCS 2026 mine statistics, IEA scenario projections, investment-project disclosures or the canonical SLI policy register.
